Tests CGOA wrapper design for cryptographic signing with an in-memory key. Emphasizes memory ownership, thread safety, and error propagation in a streaming Go workflow.

## Key Concepts

- CGO memory management across boundaries
- In-memory key handling with explicit free
- Per-call ownership transfer of out_json

Tests practical CGO ownership, memory management, and cross-language error handling with real concurrency. It reveals ability to design safe resource lifetimes and translation between Go and C types.

## Key Concepts
- CGO memory management and ownership transfer

- Managing C-allocated items from Go with precise frees
